[enter]	p/src/alpha	↑↓ move  ·  enter open  ·  x close it…  ·  ctrl+y its PR  ·  ctrl+b keep going  ·  ← the list  ·  esc back
[enter down]	p/src/alpha	↑↓ move  ·  enter open  ·  x close it…  ·  ctrl+y its PR  ·  ctrl+b keep going  ·  ← the list  ·  esc back
[enter down down]	p/src/alpha	↑↓ move  ·  x remove…  ·  c clean up  ·  r check again  ·  esc back
[enter down down down]	p/src/alpha	↑↓ move  ·  x empty it…  ·  ← back
[down]	p/Users/me/Downloads	↑↓ move  ·  enter into it  ·  c clean up  ·  esc back
[down down]	~prs	↑↓ move  ·  enter into it  ·  c clean up  ·  esc back
[down down enter]	~prs	↑↓ move  ·  enter into it  ·  c clean up  ·  esc back
[down down down]	~temp	↑↓ move  ·  enter into it  ·  c clean up  ·  esc back
[down down down enter]	~temp	↑↓ move  ·  x clear untouched…  ·  c clean up  ·  r look again  ·  esc back
[down down down enter down]	~temp	↑↓ move  ·  enter open it  ·  x delete all of it…  ·  X every finished agent's…  ·  esc back
=== clean
